claims.text: The number of selected in-domain sentences is determined by the performance on held-out data.
The selection of in-domain sentences is based on empirical results from a separate validation set.
The in-domain data used to train the selection model could be as few as 100 sentences, allowing for fine-grained topic-dependent translation adaptation.
